claims.text: LLMiser applies camera orientation tags, reads, checks orientation only on a weak read, keeps a turned copy only if clearly better
Correction works in quarter turns; small tilts are read as they are
180 and 270 copies corrected and identical to upright; 90 read correctly without correction; EXIF JPEG identical
8-degree tilt returned one line with 15% for 1.5%; rest missing; no warning
Orientation check didn't run because confidence stayed above its threshold
Stripped orientation tag means the photo gets the quarter-turn check like any image
